cohort: 25 patients diagnosed with neonatal seizure admitted at Maharat Nakhon Ratchasima Hospital, Thailand, between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2020, who received levetiracetam or phenytoin as second-line treatment.
finding: Levetiracetam did not demonstrate superior efficacy compared to phenytoin as a second-line treatment for neonatal seizures.
